rows.title: The whole view
rows.text: If you are the turtle Trachemys scripta, you have four kinds of color-sensing cell, one of them for ultraviolet, and you see about 6 cycles a degree, where a human sees about 30. For most other reptiles, nobody has measured how sharply they see. Nobody has measured how wide an area you see at once.
rows.note: Removed the word "slider" (flagged as app wording) and named the turtle by its Latin name. Left out pupil and fovea because they differ by species.
